verification: R6-01 through R6-07 LOCALLY_REMEDIATED; original independent CONDITIONAL preserved; independent re-review not performed

findings.R6-01: Filesystem ancestor and managed-file identity checks. Native case-insensitive path aliases and outside hardlinks refused; original HEAD unchanged.
findings.R6-02: Explicit owner-aware evidence cleanup CLI/Wails/Workspace action; ordinary unsaved results are never automatically evicted. Atomic owned saved-case reopen has a separate bounded 32-result/64-MiB transient reserve, independent of full ordinary cache; final lease release/startup reclaim only transient copies. Cleanup preserves shared owners and durable snapshots, then new import succeeds.
findings.R6-03: Complete-identity backend save deduplication without revision/ref growth, including returning an earlier existing reference after another result was saved. Workspace reuses current saved refs and re-saves stale refs.
findings.R6-04: Separate corrupt-case managed-tree plan/token/purge. Readable cases require normal deletion, changed trees invalidate tokens, corrupt manifests never control deletion paths, external originals and other cases survive.
findings.R6-05: Empty/partial legacy layout initializes; corrupt migration remains fail-closed with typed legacy/durable preserve/backup-rename/restart guidance. Recovery executed; original corrupt bytes and absent completion marker preserved.
findings.R6-06: One compact revision/digest/options-bound decoded source index. Repeated pages stream-verify source hashes without full decode/allocation; mtime spoof refused. All bounded bytes validated/counted; 1M-line indexed prefix disclosed with total/indexed/truncated. Returned page text owns bounded copies, so it cannot pin the full decoded cache.
findings.R6-07: Local UTF-8 display labels allow colon filenames and remain separate from strict archive/capture paths. Portable objects keep digest paths and control-character labels remain refused.

limitations: T-630 remains REVIEW pending independent re-review; local checks do not rename CONDITIONAL to PASS.
Saved-case reserve is bounded and can require closing unused results or explicit ordinary-cache cleanup; no unlimited capacity promise.
Source pages expose at most the first 1M indexed lines with honest coverage; originals/export remain complete. T-635 must honor coverage or add byte windows for more.
Streaming source integrity checks still read bounded source bytes; the local 60 MiB measurement is not a production or controlled baseline speed guarantee.
Corrupt purge is explicit, tree-token-bound and limited to managed case files; symlinks, permissions and traversal/byte limits fail closed. It does not promise physical erasure.
Ordinary evidence cleanup can remove unowned unsaved result copies: users must save/export needed data first. No external originals, saved cases or legacy backups are removed.
Existing macOS SDK/deployment-target linker warning remains.
No changes to shared assets, AnalysisResult semantics, capture security, Q01-Q04 qualification or independent Windows parity gates.
